typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		IS_EUCT as boolean,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		SANDBOX_NAME as string,
		IS_MODEL as boolean,
		IS_SANDBOX as boolean,
		IS_DROPPED as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		IS_EUCT as boolean,
		PLTFM_TXT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		IS_MODEL as boolean,
		IS_SANDBOX as boolean,
		IS_DROPPED as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ENVRN_TXT,
		IS_EUCT,
		PLTFM_TXT,
		DATABASENAME = SANDBOX_NAME,
		IS_MODEL,
		IS_SANDBOX,
		IS_DROPPED),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
